segments.t: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias.
He revealed himself this way.
Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
segments.note: 「sons」は οἱ τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου への補い。「of Cana in Galilee」は ὁ ἀπὸ Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας のほぐし

segments.t: Simon Peter said to them,
“I’m going fishing.”
They told him,
“We are also coming with you.”
They immediately went out and entered into the boat.
That night, they caught nothing.
But when day had already come,
Jesus stood on the beach;
yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
Jesus therefore said to them,
“Children, have you anything to eat?”
They answered him, “No.”
He said to them,
“Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.”
segments.note: 「side」は μέρη への補い。「some」は εὑρήσετε への補い

segments.t: They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter,
“It’s the Lord!”
So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord,
he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked),
and threw himself into the sea.
But the other disciples came in the little boat
(for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away),
dragging the net full of fish.
segments.note: 「full of」は τῶν ἰχθύων のほぐし

segments.t: So when they got out on the land,
they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
segments.note: 「a fire of coals」は ἀνθρακιάν のほぐし。「with … laid on it」は ἐπικείμενον のほぐし

segments.t: Jesus said to them,
“Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land,
full of one hundred fifty-three great fish.
Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
segments.note: 「Even though」は καὶ τοσούτων ὄντων の譲歩的なほぐし

segments.t: Jesus said to them,
“Come and eat breakfast!”
None of the disciples dared inquire of him,
“Who are you?”
knowing that it was the Lord.
Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
segments.note: 「Then」は英語の補い。「it」は ἄρτον を受ける

segments.t: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
segments.note: 「time」は τρίτον への補い。「his」は英語の補い

segments.t: So when they had eaten their breakfast,
Jesus said to Simon Peter,
“Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?”
He said to him,
“Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”
segments.note: 「have affection for」は φιλῶ のほぐし

segments.t: He said to him,
“Feed my lambs.”
He said to him again a second time,
“Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?”
He said to him,
“Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”
segments.note: 「have affection for」は φιλῶ のほぐし

segments.t: He said to him,
“Tend my sheep.”
He said to him the third time,
“Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?”
segments.note: 「son」は Ἰωάννου への補い。「have affection for」は φιλεῖς のほぐし

segments.t: Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time,
“Do you have affection for me?”
He said to him,
“Lord, you know everything.
You know that I have affection for you.”
Jesus said to him,
“Feed my sheep.
Most certainly I tell you,
segments.note: 「Most certainly」は ἀμὴν ἀμὴν のほぐし

segments.t: when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to.
But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God.
segments.note: 「by what kind of death」は ποίῳ θανάτῳ のほぐし

segments.t: When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following.
segments.note: 不定冠詞「a」は英語の補い

segments.t: This was the disciple whom Jesus loved,
segments.note: 「This was」は ὅν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς の関係節を受ける英語のほぐし

segments.t: the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked,
segments.note: 「Jesus'」は αὐτοῦ を受けて英語が補う

segments.t: “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
segments.note: 「going to」は παραδιδούς（現在分詞）のほぐし

segments.t: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
segments.note: 「about this man」は οὗτος δὲ τί のほぐし

segments.t: Jesus said to him,
“If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?
You follow me.”
This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die.
Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die,
but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
There are also many other things which Jesus did,
which if they would all be written,
I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
segments.note: 「have room」は χωρήσειν のほぐし。「itself」は αὐτόν の訳
